facts.subject: Items
facts.text: Items are used by pressing Start to open the menu, selecting ITEM, choosing the item with A, and pressing B outside menus.

evidence.quote:
1. Press Start to open the menu, then select ITEM.
2. Place the cursor next to the item you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to set the item.
4. Exit all menus and press the B Button when you wish to use said item.

facts.subject: Keys
facts.text: Keys are used by equipping them and walking directly into the door to be opened.

evidence.quote: With Keys, just equip it and walk into the door you wish to open.

facts.subject: Special Items
facts.text: Most Special and Story items are automatically used when the time is right.

evidence.quote: Most Special/Story items will be automatically used when the time is right.

facts.subject: Equipment
facts.text: Equipment is equipped by pressing Start, selecting EQUIP, placing the cursor on the gear, and pressing A twice.

evidence.quote:
1. Press Start to open the menu, then select EQUIP.
2. Place the cursor next to the weapon/armor you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to equip it.

facts.subject: Armor and Weapons

facts.subject: Status Screen
facts.text: The status screen displays the character's name, level, condition, HP, MP, Attack Power, Defense Power, gold, experience, Stamina, Power, Wisdom, and Will.

evidence.quote:
Hero - The name of your character.
L - The current level of your character.
Good - The current condition of your character.
HP - The current hit points / the total hit points.
MP - The current magic points/ the total magic points.
AP - Your character's Attack Power.
DP - Your character's Defense Power.
GP - The amount of your characters gold.
E - The characters Experience acquired / Experience needed to Level Up.
Stamina - The amount of Stamina your character has.
Power - The amount of Power your character has.
Wisdom - The amount of Wisdom your character has.
Will - The amount of Will your character has.

   Pots - Can be smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star

facts.subject: Weapon Attack
facts.text: Pressing the A button attacks enemies in weapon range, dealing damage until the enemy's HP reaches 0.

evidence.quote:
To attack enemies,
move your character so that the enemy is in range of your weapon. Then
press the A button. Every time you successfully hit the enemy he will
receive damage. Once his HP's reach 0, he will die.

facts.subject: Magic Attack
facts.text: Equipping one of six types of attack magic and pressing the B button unleashes a spell that travels straight or can be manipulated using the Directional Pad.

evidence.quote:
There are six types of magic that can be used for attacking. To use
magic on an enemy you must have the magic equipped. Then, press the B
button. Some types of magic only fly in straight lines, while others
will require you to manipulate the magic using the Directional Pad.

facts.subject: Attack Items
facts.text: There are eight different types of items used for attacking like magic, though each item has a limited number of uses.

evidence.quote:
There are eight different types of Items that can be used for attacking
the enemy. Item attacks are used the same way as magic attacks and have
the same general effect as a magic spell would. However, the damage
dealt might be different, and unlike magic, Items have a limited number
of uses.

facts.subject: Shield
facts.text: Touching a monster causes damage unless the Hero avoids it or blocks with an equipped, appropriate shield while at a higher level than that monster.

evidence.quote:
If you touch a monster, you will receive damage at once. The
only way to prevent damage is to either to avoid the monster, or touch
him with your Shield. Your Shield will only work if it is equipped, you
have the appropriate type of shield, and your level is higher than that
monster.

facts.subject: Will Meter
facts.text: When equipped with a weapon, the Will Meter increases to its maximum to enable a unique attack shared across all weapons of that type.

evidence.quote:
When you are equipped with a weapon, your Will Meter (found at the
bottom of the screen), will increase until it is at its maximum. When
it reaches its max, your weapon will attack in a unique way. The same
weapon types will have the same unique attack.

facts.subject: Swords
facts.text: At max Will, holding the A button executes a movable Spin Attack, while pressing the A button and Directional Pad executes a Charge Attack.

evidence.quote:
Swords         Spin Attack - Press and hold the A button. This will
               make your character spin with his sword. While
               spinning you can move him with the directional pad.

               Charge Attack - Press the A Button and the Directional
               pad. Your character will charge in the direction you
               pushed the Directional pad in.

facts.subject: Axes
facts.text: At max Will, an Axe is thrown in the direction the character is facing.

evidence.quote: Axes           It will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

facts.subject: Sickle
facts.text: At max Will, the Sickle extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Sickle         The Sickle will extend longer than normal

facts.subject: Chains
facts.text: At max Will, the Chain extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Chains         The Chain will extend longer than normal

facts.subject: Spears
facts.text: At max Will, a Spear is thrown in the direction the character is facing.

evidence.quote: Spears         The Spear will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

facts.subject: Morning Star
facts.text: At max Will, the Morning Star extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Morning Star   The Morning Star will extend longer than normal.

facts.subject: Consumables
facts.text: Items have limited uses and can restore HP/MP, cure status ailments, sell for gold, open doors, or establish new routes.

evidence.quote:
The different types of items in
the game are, items that recover your HP/MP, cure your status, sold for
money, open doors and create new routes, and items that can affect your
status. Items can only be used a certain number of times

facts.subject: Leveling Up
facts.text: Defeating a monster awards Experience and Gold, and reaching the required Experience gains a level which fully restores HP and MP.

evidence.quote:
Every time you defeat a monster you will gain Experience and Gold.
After gaining a certain amount of Experience you will gain a level. A
message will appear on the screen telling you that your character
leveled up, and that your HP/MP has also been restored.

facts.subject: Stat Growth
facts.text: When leveling up, choosing a stat to boost acts as the primary stat increase while potentially boosting another stat to a lesser degree.

evidence.quote:
Now a new
screen will appear. It asks you to choose what type of stat you want to
boost...The stat you choose will be the primary stat that will be boosted, some
stats will also boost a different stat, but to a lesser degree.

facts.subject: Terrain
facts.text: Terrain that your character cannot travel over includes Forests, Bushes, Rock-Walls, Oasis's, Oceans, Rivers, and Lakes.

evidence.quote: Terrain that your character CANNOT travel over...*Forests - A region covered with trees...Bushes - A region covered with large leafy plants...Rock-Walls - The walls of mountains...Oasis's - Fountains of water found in the desert...Oceans - Large bodies of water around different continents...Rivers - Small stretches of water crossing the land...Lakes - Small bodies of water surrounded by land

facts.subject: Power
facts.text: Leveling Power increases the character's Power by 2 points, raising attack power, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Power rating of your character by 2 points. This will raise the attack power of your character making it easier to defeat monsters. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

facts.subject: Stamina
facts.text: Leveling Stamina increases the Stamina rating by 2 points, raising HP and defense, while also increasing Power and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Stamina rating of your character by 2 points. This raises your HP and also concentrates on your character's defense. You will now have less damage dealt to you by enemy attacks. This will also increase your Power and Will ratings by 1 point.

facts.subject: Wisdom
facts.text: Leveling Wisdom increases the Wisdom rating by 2 points, granting additional MP and raising magic damage, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Wisdom rating of your character by 2 points. This will give you additional MP and raise the damage caused by your Magic attacks to your enemies. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

facts.subject: Will
facts.text: Leveling Will increases the Will rating by 2 points, accelerating the speed at which the Will Bar fills, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Will rating of your character by 2 points. This will increase the speed of your gauge allowing your Will Bar to fill up quicker. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

facts.subject: Poison
facts.text: Poison causes the character to lose HP rapidly and can be cured with Magic of Heal or a Pure Potion.

evidence.quote:
1. Poison
---------

Remedy- Magic of Heal or Pure Potion

facts.subject: Darkness
facts.text: Darkness blinds the character and is cured by Magic of Heal or an Eye Drop.

evidence.quote:
2. Darkness
-----------

facts.subject: Petrified
facts.text: The Petrified condition turns the character to stone and prevents movement, and can be cured with Magic of Heal or a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote:
3. Petrified
------------

Remedy- Magic of Heal or Soft Potion

facts.text: The Moogle status turns the character into a furry creature with 0 defense, and can be remedied using Magic of Heal or a Moogle Potion.

evidence.quote:
4. Moogle
----------

Remedy- Magic of Heal or Moogle Potion

facts.text: From Topple, Bogard's house is reached by traveling east two screens, south, east, north, west, north, west three screens, north two screens, south along the vines, west, and climbing north up the vine.

evidence.quote: Exit Topple and go east two screens. From here, go south, east, north, west, north, west three times, and north two screens. Then follow the vines around and go south to the next screen. Now go west a screen and climb the vine north to the next screen. Enter Bogard's house.

facts.subject: Bogard
facts.text: Talking to the old man in his house three times reveals his true identity as Bogard.

evidence.quote: Talk to the old man three times, and on the third time he will reveal his identity.

evidence.quote: He then opens the door to his back room. Go north into the room and open the treasure chest for a Mattock.

evidence.quote: Now go east twice, south, and east. Go into the little house in the middle of the screen. The man offers to sell a Battle Axe for 150 gold. Buy the Battle Axe and also a Pure Potion.

facts.subject: mirror

evidence.quote: The other person says that the man threw away a mirror in the Cave of Marsh.

facts.subject: Davias
facts.text: Davias is encircled by four circling fireballs and throws flame balls; defeat him quickly by slashing with the Were Axe inside his fireball ring, or stay at the bottom dodging flames while throwing powered-up weapons.

evidence.quote: Strategy: Davias is protected by four circling balls of flame. He attacks by shooting a ball of flame at you. He moves east and west across the top of the screen.   horizontally.

    moving heads.

You can move the cursor to different items my moving the directional
pad. To select the item of your choice, press the A button twice. To
use the item, press the B button once.

facts.subject: Magic
facts.text: Pressing the A button equips a selected spell, and pressing the B button casts it unless MP is insufficient.

press the B button. However, if you do not have sufficient MP to use

facts.text: Outside of dungeons, the general map gives a broad idea of the world, while in a dungeon it displays the dungeon's rooms and entrances, updating as each new room is entered.

dungeon is very general, only showing giving you a very broad idea of
the world. When in a dungeon, the rooms displayed will be those of the
dungeon only. Each time you enter a new room, the cave map will be
updated with the new information. The dungeon maps are much more
intricate. Dungeon maps will show you the entrances to different rooms.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest Trick
facts.text: Chest contents are determined when opened: with your item inventory full but room in equipment inventory, repeatedly attempting to open a dropped chest will eventually yield Samurai Armor, Samurai Helmet, or Aegis Shield instead of an item.

evidence.quote:
What is in a treasure chest is not determined when the chest appears,
but instead when you open it. This fact can be taken advantage of when
trying to get the Samurai Armor/Helmet and Aegis Shield. First, you must
have your item inventory full, but still have room in your Equipment
inventory. Then kill the monster carrying the equipment you want until
one of them drops a chest. Then try to open the chest. You will get a
few "Can't carry!" messages, but the chest will remain closed. Eventually
you will get armor instead of an item.

facts.subject: Ice Magic Cave Warp
facts.text: In the corner room right before Ice magic in the cave where you get Ice magic, equip a sword with max will, slide on the two plates and do the max-move to the right, then hold left while flying back to warp to the cave where you get the star.

evidence.quote:
Warp 2- In the cave where you get the Ice magic, go to the corner room
right before you get the Ice magic. Equip a sword, and put your will to
the max. While sliding on the two plates, do the max-move to the right.
Press left when you're flying back, and keep pressing left. You'll warp
to the cave where you get the star.

facts.subject: Wendel Woods Warp
facts.text: In the woods west of Wendel on the bottom road where roads intersect, face west at the western screen limit with an axe and non-full limit gauge, then attack left while moving to the left screen to warp to the snowy fields.

evidence.quote:
Warp 3- In the woods west of Wendel, there is one screen where a road
runs west to south and another road runs west to east on top of it. On
the bottom road, face west. Equip any ax and go to the western limit of
the screen. Make sure your limit gage is NOT full and attack to the
left, at the same time moving to the left screen. You'll warp to the
snowy fields.

facts.subject: Last Dungeon Warp
facts.text: On the top screen of the long zig-zag road in the last dungeon, stand at the farthest point without entering the forest-like area and repeatedly press up, press select while moving one step quickly, then save and reset to warp to the fire cave or enter the snowy fields cave with the Chocobo.

evidence.quote:
Warp 4/5- In the last dungeon, there is a long zig-zag road. On the top
screen, stand on the farthest place you can go without entering the
forest-like place. Repeat the following until you go over the top of
the screen and warp to the fire cave. 1. press up 2. press "select"
while you're moving one step. (do this quickly) 3. save, reset Use this
method in the entrance to snowy fields and you don't have to get off
the Chocobo. (You can even enter the cave with the Chocobo)

evidence.quote: After beating all the Knights in this room, get the chest for the Blood Sword.

After you’ve put the 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear on the lower right corner.

evidence.quote: The Dark Mages and the Knights give off a fair amount of EXP. So, beat all of them inside the throne room and then save. And then, reset your Gameboy by pressing A,B,Start and Select buttons AT THE SAME TIME. Now, load your game again. Do this pattern until you level up or up to how many times you want.

evidence.quote: All you have to do is to use your Morning Star. It will pass through his shield and damage him.

evidence.quote: Here, turn any 2 monsters into snowmen and push them on to the floor switches. After placing 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear.

facts.subject: Moog
facts.text: The Moog condition cannot be cured even with the Moogle Item, but asking the Chocobo for a ride and then asking again removes the condition.

evidence.quote:
The Moogle (Moog) condition cannot be cured even with the Moogle Item...First, 
ASK your Chocobo for a ride!...And then, ASK 
again and your Moog condition will be removed.

facts.subject: Moog
facts.text: Going back and forth between area edges or doorways uses up time to cure the Moog condition while preventing enemy contact.

evidence.quote:
Second, stay at the edge of the 
current area (in world map/field) or stay in front of the doorways (dungeons, 
towns, etc.) and go back and forth between this area and the other area. This 
will use the time and prevents enemy contact.

facts.subject: Pois Condition
facts.text: Moving back and forth between area edges or doorways will cure poison over time while limiting HP loss to at most 2 times.

evidence.quote:
Stay at the edge of the current area (in world map/field) or stay in 
front of the doorways (dungeons, towns, etc.) and go back and forth between 
this area and the other area. This will use up the time but will definitely 
cure Poison after a while. Doing this also lessens the effect of the poison. 
Your HP will drop at most 2 times only.

facts.subject: Pois Condition
facts.text: Asking the Heroine when she is with you counters the Pois effect by healing the exact amount of HP lost each time poison damages the character.

evidence.quote:
If the Heroine is with you, ASK her. This will 
counter the Pois effect. Every time Pois cuts down your HP, the heroine will 
heal that same amount of HP lost. Therefore, no change of HP will occur when 
in Pois Condition.

facts.subject: Pois Condition
facts.text: Hitting the A button rapidly makes the character attack continuously, which slows down the Pois condition and stops the depletion of HP.

evidence.quote:
Hitting the A button rapidly will make your 
character attack continuously. This will slow down the Pois condition. It will 
stop the depletion of your HP.

facts.subject: Townspeople
facts.text: People in towns can be killed in about 3-5 hits using strongest weapons, and they speak their lines afterwards.

evidence.quote:
In towns, YOU CAN KILL THE PEOPLE! Just be patient though. They have a high 
HP and won’t go down easily. When you use your strongest weapons, about 3-5 
hits will do. If you beat them, they will say their lines afterwards.

facts.subject: Enemies
facts.text: Leaving one enemy alive in an area causes enemies to respawn when leaving and returning.

evidence.quote:
But, if you left one of them, alive, and then came back again, the 
enemies will respawn. This is good for leveling up and collecting GPs.

facts.subject: Cracked Wall
facts.text: Striking a wall that produces a cranking sound indicates a Mattock or Morning Star can destroy that wall to reveal a new path.

evidence.quote:
When you strike a wall with a weapon and you hear a cranking sound, use 
your mattock or Morning Star to destroy that wall and reveal a new path.

facts.subject: Empty Chest
facts.text: An empty chest blocking the way can be destroyed with a weapon to make it disappear.

evidence.quote:
If an empty chest gets in your way, destroy it with your weapon and it will 
simply, disappear.

facts.subject: Rocks
facts.text: Standing between adjacent rocks and pressing the B button with a Mattock breaks 2 rocks in one shot, or they can be attacked head on with a Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
If there are a lot of rocks, and they are beside each other, you can break 
them in one shot. With the Mattock, stand in between the rocks and then press 
the B button. The 2 rocks will disappear. With the Morning Star, just attack 
the rocks head on.

facts.subject: Mattock
facts.text: All Mattocks can be sold once the Morning Star is acquired to free up item inventory space for items such as Keys.

evidence.quote:
Once you acquire the Morning Star, you won’t have any need for the 
Mattocks anymore. So, just sell ALL your mattocks to save space in the Items 
Inventory. This will enable you to get more important items such as Keys.

evidence.quote:

back and forth beating all those wolves, walruses, and Snowmen. The second one 
is near Julius. I kept on killing those elephants. Either way you’ll get good 
experience points and GP.

facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: Use the Fire Flail against Lich, staying at the bottom to dodge his sideways figure-8 swoop and skull projectiles.

evidence.quote:
A really tough boss, even if you don't come here early. Your weapon of
choice is the Fire Flail. He mostly sticks to a sideways figure 8 pattern.
Stay at the bottom and move left or right accordingly as he turns to
swoop towards you. He should narrowly pass you by, while the skull
projectiles fly at your previous position.

facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: When Lich flies south off-screen, move up along with him and return to the bottom once he passes.

evidence.quote:
He will periodically fly off-screen to the left or south and then appear
from the other side. When he goes south, you have to mix things up a bit,
as it's not safe at the bottom. You need to go "up" along with him, and
then quickly get back to the bottom after he passes you by.

facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: Lich's skull projectiles can be destroyed by attacking them, although the angles make it difficult to do consistently.

evidence.quote: And most of all, DON’T EVER TOUCH HIM! You’ll receive a very large amount of damage!...Note: You can hit the Skulls with your weapons.

He will periodically fly off-screen to the left or south and then appear
from the other side. When he goes south, you have to mix things up a bit,
as it's not safe at the bottom. You need to go "up" along with him, and
then quickly get back to the bottom after he passes you by.

You can destroy the skull projectiles by attacking them, but it's difficult
to do consistently because of the angles.

facts.text: Press the top button, then use two Mattocks to reach and press the second button to make the stairs appear.

evidence.quote: Go W, S, E(K), Down ... - Press the top button, then use two Mattocks to reach the second button to make the Stairs appear.

facts.subject: Hydra
facts.text: Hydra inflicts up to 13 damage, and mashing the Attack button after taking a hit extends your invincibility time.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Hydra ... Hydra deals up to 13 damage; keep your HP above that. ... Mash the Attack button to extend your invincibility after being hit for an abnormally long time.

facts.subject: Hydra Room Chests
facts.text: After opening the first chest in Hydra's room, attack it to access the second chest.

evidence.quote: - Take chests ... Attack the first chest after opening it to reach the second.

facts.subject: Werewolf
facts.text: Equip the Mirror and Axe and speak to the butler to fight Werewolf, who deals about 10 damage and dies in 4 Axe hits.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Werewolf ... Equip Mirror and Axe, and talk to butler. ... Werewolf deals about 10 damage, and may hit you right at the start. ... 4 Axe hits will kill him.

facts.subject: Owl
facts.text: Owls drop Crystals, while Zombies drop Ethers or Wisdom Crystals.

evidence.quote: Owls drop Crystals, while Zombies drop Ethers or Wisdom Crystals.

facts.subject: Zombie
facts.text: Zombies can be destroyed with the Fire spell or with 2 hits from a Mattock.

evidence.quote: Zombies can be killed with Fire, or with 2 Mattocks if you are desperate.

facts.subject: Mice
facts.text: Owls, Pumpkins, and Mice all die to either 2 weapon hits or 1 cast of Fire.

evidence.quote: Owls, Pumpkins, and Mice all die to either 2 weapon hits or 1 Fire cast.

facts.subject: Urn Button
facts.text: Break the urn with a Mattock to press the button that makes stairs appear.

evidence.quote: Press button (use Mattock to bust urn) to make the stairs appear.

facts.subject: Chain Chest Trap
facts.text: Take the Chain from the chest and use it to escape the trap.

evidence.quote: Go E, N, N(K) ... - Take Chain, then use it to escape the trap.

facts.subject: Balcony
facts.text: Traversing the balcony in Kett's requires the Chain weapon.

evidence.quote: * This is the balcony. ... Go W, W(Chain), S(leaves balcony)

facts.subject: Chest Switch
facts.text: Push the chest onto the button to reveal the stairs.

evidence.quote: Push the chest on the button to make the stairs appear.

facts.subject: Basement Urn
facts.text: Use a Mattock on the urn to reveal the staircase down.

evidence.quote: Go Down ... - Mattock the Urn to reveal the stairs.

facts.subject: Girl
facts.text: Behind the locked door, the Girl is positioned in the bottom row, 3 spaces from the left.

evidence.quote: Go E, S(K) ... - The Girl is in the bottom row, 3 from the left.

facts.subject: Vampire
facts.text: Attack Vampire with Fire while he moves and strike him from below with the Chain while he stops, destroying his incoming bats.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Vampire ... Attack with Fire while he's moving. ... Attack from a distance below him with the Chain while he's standing still. ... Your Chain should destroy the bats as they approach.

facts.subject: Moblin
facts.text: Moblin-like enemies require either 2 Fire spells or 1 Fire plus 1 or 2 Chain hits.

evidence.quote: The Moblin-esque enemies either require 2 Fires or 1 and a Chain hit or two.

facts.subject: Bee
facts.text: Bees are dangerous and should be eliminated with Fire before walking past them.

evidence.quote: Bees are dangerous.  Kill them with Fire before walking by.

facts.subject: Heal
facts.text: Following the cutscenes with Cibba and Julius in Wendel, you learn the Heal spell.

evidence.quote: - Keep going North until Cibba cutscene. ... - Keep going South until Julius cutscene. ... You will learn Heal.  Heal sets your defense power to 0 until the next time you pause.

facts.subject: Wendel Inn
facts.text: Rest at the Inn in Wendel to restore your MP.

evidence.quote: Go S, S(exits interior), S(enters town), S, Door (enters Inn) ... - Sleep in Inn to recover MP.

facts.subject: Crab
facts.text: Crab enemies drop Nectar.

evidence.quote: - Get at least 1, hopefully 2 Nectars from the Crab enemies.

facts.subject: Silver Mine Entrance
facts.text: From outside the shop, head north using Chain and Axe to cut a path to the door of the Silver Mine.

evidence.quote: Go S(Exits shop), N, N(Chain), N, N(Axe), W(Axe) ... Cut a path East, then North to the clearing, then West, North, West to your destination. ... Use Door (Enters Silver Mine)

facts.subject: shop
facts.text: Buy Oil, 2x Key, and 2x Mattock here.

evidence.quote: Buy Oil, 2x Key, and 2x Mattock here.

facts.subject: Face
facts.text: Face enemies outside the castle can be killed in one hit with a full Will bar Morning Star attack.

evidence.quote:
There will be some Face enemies; if you have a full Will bar, the Morning
  Star will kill them in one hit.

facts.subject: Chimera
facts.text: Chimera is invulnerable to Lit and must be damaged rapidly with Fire.

evidence.quote:
Chimera is invulnerable to Lit; Fire must be used.
--- Cast Fire rapidly.

facts.subject: Chimera
facts.text: Chimera dives dealing about 45 damage when reaching the center of the screen, so cast Cure if HP is below 50.

evidence.quote:
Specifically, each time he reaches the center of the screen, he may dive.
--- This deals about 45 damage; if your HP is below 50, cast Cure.

facts.subject: Girl
facts.text: The Girl heals you when you use her ASK command.

evidence.quote: The Girl can heal you with her ASK command.  Do this often.

facts.subject: Wizard
facts.text: Wizards inflict Stone with magic or Moogle on contact, and can only be defeated with about 10 Morning Star hits.

evidence.quote:
Wizards can be killed with about 10 Morning Star hits, but are otherwise
    invincible.
--- Wizards inflict Stone with their magic, or Moogle from touching them.

facts.subject: Dark Knight
facts.text: Dark Knights can be killed with a single Fire cast when struck from the side or back.

evidence.quote:
Dark Knights can be killed with a single Fire cast, but have to be hit
    from the side or the back.

facts.subject: Flashing
facts.text: While flashing from damage, you cannot press a button and cannot enter stairs.

evidence.quote:
While you are flashing from damage, you cannot press a button, and you
  cannot enter Stairs.

facts.subject: Werewolf Room
facts.text: If any treasure chests in the Werewolf room are destroyed or moved, the stairs will disappear.

evidence.quote:
The way this Werewolf room works is, if any of the treasure chests are
  destroyed or moved, the stairs wil disappear.

facts.subject: Ice Room
facts.text: Solving the Ice room puzzle requires turning Dark Knights into snowmen and pushing one onto each of the two buttons.

evidence.quote:
The goal is to push a snowman onto each of the two buttons.
- Only the Dark Knights can be turned into snowmen.

facts.subject: Dark Lord
facts.text: Dark Lord deals about 55 damage and can only be harmed by the Lit spell.

evidence.quote:
Dark Lord deals about 55 damage.  Cast cure if you're below 60 HP.
- Dark Lord can only be hurt by Lit.

facts.subject: Dark Lord
facts.text: You can get Dark Lord stuck in the upper corner of the arena, walk into him with Lit equipped to turn him away, and blast his backside with Lit.

evidence.quote: The Dark Lord will run around and try to hit you with his sword. The Dark Lord is able to use a MAX type attack with his sword and he is able to follow your movements. Dodge around him and strike him until he is defeated.

Equip Cure and run off to the upper right or upper left corner of the arena.
- If Dark Lord is 1/2 tile to the side (rather than exactly aligned with you),
  he may get stuck rather than actually running into you....Wait for your Will meter to fill.
- Equip Lit and walk down into Dark Lord.
--- This will make him turn away from you.
- Cast Lit.
--- This should hit his backside.

facts.subject: Ish Weapon Shop
facts.text: Flame Armor is purchased at the Weapon Shop in Ish.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Weapon Shop.
--- Buy Flame Armor

facts.subject: Chocobot
facts.text: After sleeping at the Inn in Ish, go west through the door and speak to Chocobot outside town to recruit him.

evidence.quote:
Go W, Door
- Sleep at the Inn.
Go W, Door
- You now have the Chocobot.

Go E, S, S (Exits Ish)
- Talk to your Chocobot to recruit him.

facts.subject: Lorim Snowfields Enemies
facts.text: Wolves and Snowmen in Lorim Snowfields die in one Fire cast, while Walruses die to Fire with a mostly full Will meter.

evidence.quote:
Wolves and Snowmen die in one Fire cast, while Walruses will die if the
    Will meter is mostly full.

facts.subject: Eye
facts.text: Eyes in the Ice Cavern are invincible and inflict Stone status.

evidence.quote: Eyes are invincible, and they inflict Stone.

facts.subject: Poto
facts.text: Potos die in 1 Fire cast and drop X-Ethers.

evidence.quote: Potos (the white jumping things) die in 1 Fire cast, and drop X-Ethers.

facts.subject: Duck Knight
facts.text: Duck Knights die to 2 Fire casts or a Fire cast with a nearly full Will bar.

evidence.quote: Duck Knights die in 2 Fire casts or with a nearly full Will bar.

facts.subject: Ice
facts.text: Ice tiles behave like one-way conveyor belts rather than standard slippery surfaces.

evidence.quote:
Something to understand: ice in this game is actually a 1-way conveyor belt,
  rather than behaving like you'd expect ice to behave.

facts.subject: Recovery Pond
facts.text: A recovery pond is located behind a Mattockable northern wall after climbing the stairs with two horizontal lines of ice.

evidence.quote:
You should emerge from the stairs on a screen with two horizontal lines of
  ice, and an obviously Mattockable wall to the north.
- There is a recovery pond to the north, if you need it.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Kary is immune to Nuke, and only her head is vulnerable to attacks.

evidence.quote:
If for some reason you got Nuke before coming here, she is immune to Nuke.
- Only her head is vulnerable.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: To defeat Kary, hit her head with Fire, then Lit, then Lit again while dodging her icicles and charges.

evidence.quote:
You will hit her with Fire, then Lit, then Lit again

- Dodge her initial icicles.

As she crosses back in front of you, hit her head with Lit.
--- Retreat to the top again immediately!

- Aim to the right, and start shooting Lit right as her left hands pass you.
--- With proper timing, you'll hit her head as she stars moving upward again.
- Walk downward, dodge her charge and icicles, and repeat the pattern.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Defeating Kary awards the Ice Sword.

evidence.quote: Win Ice Sword.

facts.subject: Cibba
facts.text: Talking to Cibba in Lorim gives you the Bone Key.

evidence.quote: Talk to Cibba and you'll get the Bone Key.

facts.subject: Elixir Island
facts.text: Defeating all the fire-breathing sea horses with Lit on Elixir Island makes an Elixir appear.

evidence.quote:
Item: Elixir                                    \\\ Island (P3) ||
- Defeat the Seadragon(s) to make a chest appear.
Your goal is to use Lit to kill all the (fire breathing) sea horses....Collect the Elixir that appears.

facts.subject: Ammonite Coast Enemies
facts.text: Manta Rays inflict Poison, and Griffin Hands inflict Moogle status which can be removed by mounting the Chocobo.

evidence.quote:
Manta Rays inflict Poison.
--- Griffin Hands inflict Moogle.  You can un-moogle yourself by hopping on
    the Chocobo.

facts.subject: Floatrocks
facts.text: Floatrocks in the Floatrock Fields can be destroyed using the Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
This takes you to the Floatrock Fields.
- Floatrocks can be destroyed by the Morning Star.

facts.subject: Kraken's Cave
facts.text: Kraken's Cave in the Floatrock Fields is opened by equipping the Bone Key.

evidence.quote: Enter this cave by equipping the Bone Key.

facts.subject: Kraken
facts.text: Kraken's tentacles are invulnerable; cast full Will meter Fire spells at his head from the second bridge tile from the right.

evidence.quote:
Cast one Fire as soon as you enter the room, then run to the second Bridge
  tile from the right.
--- This square is as close as you can be to the Kraken's right tentacle
    without taking damage.
- Only cast when your Will meter is full.
- The Tentacles are not vulnerable, only his head is.

facts.subject: Earth Elemental
facts.text: Earth Elementals in the Undersea Volcano die in 1 Lit cast and drop X-Ethers.

evidence.quote: Earth Elementals die in 1 Lit cast and drop X-Ethers.

facts.subject: Lava
facts.text: Crossing lava deals about three-quarters of your maximum health in damage.

evidence.quote: Lava will deal about 3/4 of your health in damage.

facts.subject: Iflyte
facts.text: Iflyte is vulnerable to Lit on his head, including when he bounces around in ball form.

evidence.quote:
Use Lit.
- Like Metal Crab, only his head is vulnerable.
- His head is still vulnerable when he's in ball form; aim for the center and
  lead your target as he bounces around.

facts.subject: Iflyte
facts.text: Defeating Iflyte rewards the Rusty Sword.

evidence.quote: Once the Iflyte dies you get the Rusty Sword.
Win the Rusty Sword.

facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: Lich deals about 100 damage per hit and should be countered with fully charged Lit spells following Megapede's movement pattern.

evidence.quote:
This boss deals about 100 damage per hit.
- Use fully charged Lit spells.

- Lich follows the same movement pattern as Megapede.

facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: Defeating Lich rewards the Nuke spell.

evidence.quote: Win the Nuke spell.

facts.subject: Crystal Desert
facts.text: From getting Nuke, navigate south, east, north, east, north, east, south to the ocean dock, then south, south, east across the ocean to reach the Crystal Desert dock.

evidence.quote:
* From outside Ish go west, north twice, and west. There should be two
crystals near the middle of the screen. Use the Nuke spell on the right
crystal and it will reveal a hole. Go into the hole into the cave.

Go S, E, N, E, N, E, S
- Use dock to enter ocean
Go S, S, E
- Use dock to get onto the Crystal Desert

facts.subject: Ruins entrance
facts.text: The entrance to the Ruins is revealed by casting Nuke on the right crystal.

evidence.quote: Reveal the entrance by casting Nuke on the right crystal.

facts.subject: Mirrors
facts.text: Mirrors fire projectiles while Snails do not, and both enemies die from a single Nuke cast.

evidence.quote:
Mirrors have projectiles.  Snails do not.
--- Both die in a single Nuke cast.

facts.subject: Robots
facts.text: Robots in the Ruins can be defeated with Lit magic, whereas Nuke does not affect them.

evidence.quote: If you must kill one, Lit works, while Nuke does not.

facts.subject: Experience
facts.text: Snails, Mirrors, Earth Elementals, and Moths each yield 100-150 Experience.

evidence.quote:
Each of those enemies is 100-150 Experience, and you can see how close to
    a level you are on the Status screen or by saving.

facts.subject: Center tiles
facts.text: To proceed north, step on the left half of the center tiles until pushed to the right side, then step on the upper right tile.

evidence.quote:
To go north here, use the left half of the center tiles until you get kicked
  to the right side, then use the upper right tile.

To go east here, use the left half of the center tiles until you get kicked
  to the upper side, the use the upper right tile.

facts.subject: Center tiles
facts.text: To proceed east, step on the left half of the center tiles until kicked to the upper side, then use the upper right tile.

evidence.quote:
To go east here, use the left half of the center tiles until you get kicked
  to the upper side, the use the upper right tile.

facts.subject: Mantis Ant
facts.text: Against Mantis Ant, stay still and cast Fire whenever the Will meter fills.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Mantis Ant
- Don't move.
- Cast Fire when your Will meter fills.

facts.subject: Damage tiles
facts.text: Equip Cure after defeating Mantis Ant to survive the 100HP damage tiles while crossing the arena to the right exit.

evidence.quote:
After he's dead, equip Cure, and survive the 100HP damage tiles as you enter
  the arena then exit to the right.

facts.subject: Rusty Sword
facts.text: Equipping the Rusty Sword and pressing the button releases its mystic power.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Rusty Sword
- Press the button.
"The Rusty Sword released it is mystic power..."

facts.subject: Ruins
facts.text: From the Ruins, travel south, south, east, south, and west through the desert to enter Dime Tower.

evidence.quote:
- Get Chocobo.
- Goal: arrive at Dime Tower.
Go S, S, E, S, W
Door (Enters Dime Tower)

facts.subject: Marcie
facts.text: Marcie joins the party inside Dime Tower.

evidence.quote: * Marcie joins.

facts.subject: Marcie
facts.text: Using Marcie's ASK command completely restores your MP.

evidence.quote: Marcie's ASK command gives you full MP.

facts.subject: Birdmen
facts.text: Birdmen in Dime Tower can inflict poison, while the beret-wearing fuzzballs can inflict Moogle status.

evidence.quote: Birdmen can poison, while the Beret wearing fuzzballs can Moogle.

facts.subject: Ice
facts.text: The Ice spell can be steered diagonally, allowing you to freeze Minotaurs without cutting trees that let Marcie destroy them.

evidence.quote:
You can steer the Ice spell to go diagonally.
--- This can help to avoid having to cut trees that enable Marcie to kill your
    snowmen.

facts.subject: Garuda
facts.text: Hiding in the lower left corner evades Garuda's dive when he is on the left side, and hiding in the lower right corner evades him when he is on the right.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: Garuda will dive across the screen and throw feathers at you.
Garuda will also swoop down to the middle of the screen and drop more
feathers on you. The trick is to wait in the corner below, but at a
striking distance where the tip of your Flame Chain just reaches
Garuda. Use your Flame Chain to destroy the feathers Garuda drops and
to hit Garuda himself. When he swoops down he will miss you. Then go to
the other corner and attack Garuda again.

When Garuda is on the left side, being in the lower left corner will evade
  his dive.
- Likewise, when he is on the right, hide in the lower right.

facts.subject: Garuda
facts.text: Garuda can be defeated using fully charged Nuke blasts.

evidence.quote: Kill Garuda with fully charged Nuke blasts.

facts.subject: Marcie
facts.text: Marcie leaves the party before you automatically ascend the Waterfall.

evidence.quote:
- Marcie leaves
Go W, W, W
- You'll automatically go up the Waterfall.

facts.subject: Ninjas
facts.text: Ninjas fire projectiles dealing around 90 damage, and both Ninjas and Fiend Heads can instantly teleport directly on top of you.

evidence.quote:
Ninjas' projectiles deal around 90 damage.
--- Fiend Heads and Ninjas can both instantaneously teleport anywhere -
    including directly on top of you.

facts.subject: Dragon
facts.text: The Dragon's only vulnerable square is the front foot beneath his head, as shots aimed at his head will be intercepted by his wing.

evidence.quote:
The dragon attacks with fireballs, which you can luckily
block with your shield. You may only attack the Dragon in the head, his
scales protect him from hits to the body.

The only vulnerable square is the foot underneath his head.
--- Do NOT target his head!  His wing will intercept shots that high.
--- Again: target his FRONT FOOT.

facts.subject: Dragon
facts.text: Defeat the Dragon using fully charged Nukes, taking advantage of post-hit invincibility from weak fireballs to cast uninterrupted.

evidence.quote:
Use fully charged Nukes.
--- Be careful not to let your cast get interrupted by the (weak) fireballs.
--- Consider intentionally taking a hit from fireballs, then using the
    invincibility time to cast your spell uninterrupted.

facts.subject: Ice
facts.text: In the first Ice room, steer the Ice spell through the labyrinth across the orb to freeze the Minotaur onto the button.

evidence.quote:
This is an Ice room.
- Steer the Ice spell through the labrynth, across the orb and to the Minotaur
  on the button.

facts.subject: Red Dragon
facts.text: Red Dragon has more HP than the previous Dragon, but is otherwise identical in behavior.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Red Dragon
- This boss has more HP than the last one.  Aside from that, it's identical.

facts.subject: Button
facts.text: In the second Ice room of the Tower of Gemma, the correct floor button is on the left side of the room, second from the bottom.

evidence.quote:
This is an Ice room.
- The correct button is on the left side of the room, second from the bottom.

facts.subject: Dragon Zombie
facts.text: Dragon Zombie aims fireballs directly toward you, and attacking from below with Nuke helps hit his erratically moving heads.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: Dragon Zombie
- This boss is like Hydra, except its fireballs aim toward you rather than
  horizontally.
- Fire is my choice; Nuke could be okay if you have a lot of X-Ethers left.
--- If you use Nuke, attack from below so that you don't miss his erratically
    moving heads.

facts.subject: XCalibr
facts.text: You obtain the XCalibr along the one-way path after teleporting from Dragon Zombie.

evidence.quote:
- The path here is one-way, so I won't bother giving directions.
- You'll get the XCalibr.

facts.subject: Julius 1
facts.text: Julius 1's Nukes deal about 20 damage while touching him deals about 100 damage, and fully charged Nukes kill the clones in 1 hit.

evidence.quote:
His Nukes deal about 20 damage, while touching him deals about 100 damage.
- He can move in a variety of ways, he can slowly fade out and reappear in the
  destination he was walking to, or he can instantly teleport.
--- Instant teleporting is allowed to target your current square, so keep
    yourself above 100 HP.
- Use fully charged Nukes, and you should kill the Julius clones in 1 hit.

You MUST kill the final Julius 1 clone while standing on the left or bottom
  side of the screen!

facts.subject: Julius 1
facts.text: You must defeat the final Julius 1 clone while standing on the left or bottom side of the screen.

evidence.quote:
You MUST kill the final Julius 1 clone while standing on the left or bottom
  side of the screen!

facts.subject: Julius 2
facts.text: Avoid attacking Julius 2 from below when he is on the left or right sides to prevent being caught by his dangerous diagonal dive.

evidence.quote:
The diagonal dive is dangerous; don't attack Julius 2 from below when he's
  on the right or left side or else you cannot avoid the diagonal dive.

facts.subject: Julius 3
facts.text: Julius 3 fires 2 Nukes from set positions with invincible hands; his Nukes can be intercepted by timed shots from opposite positions.

evidence.quote:
At each position, Julius will raise his hands then fire 2 Nukes toward you.
- His hands are invincible.
- Below are instructions.
--- The format is Enemy Position: Your position, your action.

Top Center: Bottom Center, walk left until shoot up.
Left: Right Center, shoot left (time shot to intercept Julius's Nukes)

facts.subject: HP
facts.text: Your maximum HP equals 19 + (Stamina * Stamina) * 0.1, with any fractional HP truncated.

evidence.quote:
Your max HP = 19 + (Stamina * Stamina) * 0.1
Fractional HP is truncated.

facts.subject: Will bar
facts.text: Each point of Will increases the Will bar by 0.00625 each second.

evidence.quote: Each point of Will grants 0.00625 of the Will bar each second.

facts.subject: Damage calculation
facts.text: Damage taken from enemies is calculated as Enemy's Attack - (Your Stamina + Your Armor + Your Helmet).

evidence.quote:
When enemies attack you, damage works like this:
Damage = Enemy's Attack - (Your Stamina + Your Armor + Your Helmet)

facts.subject: Physical attack
facts.text: Physical damage equals (1 + Will%) * (Power + Weapon Base Power - Enemy's Defense), doubling when the Will bar is full.

evidence.quote:
Damage = (1 + Will%) * (Power + Weapon Base Power - Enemy's Defense)

Will% is what fraction of the Will meter is full.
So, if you have a full Will bar, damage is doubled.

facts.subject: Sword
facts.text: The Sword's spinning special attack and the return trip of the Flying Sword Attack both calculate damage as though Will% = 0.

evidence.quote:
The Sword's spinning special attack acts as though Will% = 0.
--- The Sword's return trip from the Flying Sword Attack acts as though
    Will% = 0.

facts.subject: Magical attack
facts.text: Magical damage equals (1 + Will%) * (2 * Wisdom + Spell's Base Damage - Magic Resistance), and is multiplied by 2 if Will% = 100%.

evidence.quote:
Damage = (1 + Will%) * (2 * Wisdom + Spell's Base Damage - Magic Resistance)
         Damage multiplied by 2 if Will% = 100%

facts.subject: Wisdom
facts.text: Each point of Wisdom provides 2 points of damage on uncharged spells and 8 points of damage on fully charged spells.

evidence.quote:
So, if you fire uncharged spells, each point of Wisdom grants 2 points of
damage, whereas for fully charged spells, each Wisdom point grants 8 points of
damage.

facts.subject: Flame Chain
facts.text: All enemies immune to the Flame Chain are immune to Fire, but some enemies weak against the Flame Chain are not weak against Fire.

evidence.quote:
Although all enemies immune to the Flame Chain are immune to Fire, some
enemies weak against the Flame Chain are not weak against Fire.

facts.subject: Dragon Armor
facts.text: Go W, N(K), E to get the Dragon Armor.

evidence.quote:
Go W, N(K), E
- Get the Dragon Armor

facts.subject: Silver Mine
facts.text: To survive the mine cart ride in the Silver Mine, equip Oil, walk into the cart, attack Spiders while passing through them, and hit the second and third switches.

evidence.quote:
Goal: survive the mine cart ride.
--- Equip Oil and walk into the cart.
--- Attack any Spiders as you pass through them in hopes of avoiding damage.
--- Hit the second and third switches as you pass by them.

facts.subject: Silver Mine
facts.text: Missing switches during the mine cart ride loops the cart back to the beginning.

evidence.quote: If you miss, you'll loop back to the beginning.

facts.subject: Spider
facts.text: Spiders in the Silver Mine can be killed with 1 Fire or 2 Chain hits, but are not worth much experience.

evidence.quote:
Spiders can be killed with 1 Fire or 2 Chain hits.  They are not worth
    much experience.

facts.subject: Flea
facts.text: Fleas are worth a lot of experience and die to 1 Fire.

evidence.quote: Fleas are worth a lot of experience.  Kill with 1 Fire.

facts.subject: Stairs
facts.text: In the Silver Mine, smashing the pot and pressing the button reveals the stairs.

evidence.quote: Smash the pot and press the button to reveal the stairs.

facts.subject: Megapede
facts.text: Megapede follows a set looping path and takes damage when its head is hit with Fire.

evidence.quote:
Megapede follows a set path.
--- It enters from the right, does some loops, then exits to top.
--- Then, it enters from bottom, does some loops, and exits to left.  Repeat....Hit Megapede's head with Fire.

facts.subject: Silver Mine
facts.text: Taking the chest after defeating Megapede exits the cave.

evidence.quote: Take the chest to exit the cave.

facts.subject: Watts
facts.text: Talking to Watts in the Dwarf Village allows buying Silver Armor and the Silver Sword.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Watts and buy the Silver Armor.

  Armor so you can kill the Crab and Spider enemies easier without MP.

facts.subject: Door

evidence.quote:
The door here will close when you pass through the pillars.  Enter the
  pillars a second time to open them again.

facts.subject: Bogard
facts.text: Bogard shows up upon exiting Gaia.

evidence.quote:
Go Up (Exits Gaia)
* Bogard shows up here.

facts.subject: Crab
facts.text: Crabs south of Gaia die to 2 Silver Sword hits and drop Nectar.

evidence.quote:
The Crabs are nice because they can be killed with the Silver Sword in 2
    hits, and because they drop Nectar.

facts.subject: Cloud
facts.text: Clouds drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.

evidence.quote: Clouds drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.  Ignore the Pebbler's drops.

facts.subject: Chain

evidence.quote: Press the right button to access the left button.

evidence.quote: Basilisks die in a single fire shot.  Ignore their treasure.

2 Palm trees make 3 lanes (between them, to the right of them, to the left

evidence.quote: Use Ice to freeze a Spider, and push the snowman onto the button.

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:

facts.subject: Stairs

evidence.quote: Make the stairs appear by pressing the right, up, left, then down button.

facts.subject: Were Axe

evidence.quote:
